title: 3-Day Amman & Petra Short Break
metaTitle: Amman to Petra | 3-Day Jordan City & Heritage Trip
metaDescription: Combine Amman's historic landmarks with the ancient city of Petra on a focused 3-day Jordan journey created for travelers planning a short stay.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 3-Day Amman & Petra Tour keeps the itinerary deliberately narrow, concentrating on Jordan’s capital and its best-known archaeological site rather than attempting a wider circuit. Begin in Amman before traveling south to Petra, where the Siq leads into a Nabataean city carved and constructed among sandstone mountains. With only three days available, the route leaves out the Dead Sea and Wadi Rum to preserve enough time for Petra itself.
Private road transportation connects Amman and Petra, with departures possible throughout the year. The program provides selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and the scheduled sightseeing included in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Drive from Amman to Petra
itinerary.text: Drive to Petra, Jordan’s most famous attraction. Explore the ancient Nabataean city known as the red-rose city and walk through the Siq to reach the impressive Al-Khazneh. Continue to the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. Optional horse ride available at the entrance of Petra. Overnight in Petra.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 3-Day Amman & Petra Holiday Package?
faqs.a: The 3-Day Amman & Petra Holiday Package covers Amman and Petra, Jordan's most famous cultural and historical destinations. This private itinerary allows travelers to explore the capital city of Amman and discover the spectacular UNESCO World Heritage Site of Petra. The tour runs for 2 nights and 3 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 3-Day Amman & Petra Holiday Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €775 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, an English-speaking driver, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and airport and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the journey. You will travel in a comfortable private vehicle with an English-speaking driver, ensuring a convenient and flexible travel experience.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations in Amman and near Petra.

faqs.q: Is a guide included in the tour?
faqs.a: This package includes an English-speaking driver rather than a full-time tour guide. Local guides can be arranged at Petra upon request. Your driver will assist with transportation, logistics, and general travel information throughout the trip.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is perfect for first-time visitors with limited time who wish to experience Jordan's most famous attraction while also exploring the highlights of the capital city.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and uneven terrain. Petra requires several kilometers of walking, including the famous Siq pathway leading to the Treasury.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Amman and Petra?
faqs.a:
Q8. What are the highlights of Amman and Petra?

Amman offers a fascinating mix of ancient and modern attractions, including the Citadel, Roman Theater, and vibrant local markets. Petra is Jordan's most iconic UNESCO World Heritage Site, renowned for the Treasury, Monastery, royal tombs, and extraordinary rock-carved architecture.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 3-Day Amman & Petra Holiday Package?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 3-Day Amman & Petra Holiday Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include destinations such as Wadi Rum, the Dead Sea, Jerash, or Madaba, or arrange local guides for a more in-depth experience. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
